title: Practice: one shared setup for exploring a legacy system and generating boilerplate (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 every mcp tool reference belongs to a configured server
cases.says: Every MCP tool reference, in the subagents and in the permission rules, names a configured server

cases.id: e1 credentials come from the environment and the token has no default
cases.says: No literal credential; the token is a ${VAR} reference with no default

cases.id: e2 the explorer is read only and says when to use it
cases.says: The explorer is read only, lists its tools and says when to use it

cases.id: e3 the scaffolder writes only in the generated folder
cases.says: The scaffolder has no Bash and every edit or write rule is limited to the generated folder

cases.id: e4 the tickets server is read only for agents
cases.says: Create and delete ticket tools are denied and only read tools of the ticket server are allowed

cases.id: e5 the environment file is denied and no whole tool is approved
cases.says: The environment file is denied and no allow rule approves a whole tool

cases.id: e6 the team note lists every variable and says which session to start
cases.says: The note lists every variable and maps three situations to resume, fork or fresh

cases.id: e7 no file holds a personal path an address or a key
cases.says: No personal path, address or key in any file
